targets.authors: Kakar, V., Franco, J., Voelz, J., & Wu, J.
targets.title: The visible host: Does race guide Airbnb rental rates in San Francisco?
targets.evidence_quote: Finally, we test for an effect of host race on apartment prices. This provides a replication of previous studies reporting that, compared to White host, Black and Asian hosts charge lower prices for similar apartments (Edelman & Luca, 2014; Kakar, Franco, Voelz, & Wu, 2016; Wang, Xi, & Gilheany, 2015).
targets.outcome_quote: Examining the influence of these other cues, we found that Black hosts charge on average 10.09% less for their apartments. This in line with the price gap of approximately 12% reported FACIAL ATTRACTIVENESS & TRUSTWORTHINESS ON AIRBNB 17 by Edelman and Luca (2014). However, in contrast to previous studies that analyzed Airbnb listing in San Francisco, Oakland, and Berkeley (Kakar et al., 2016; Wang et al., 2015), we did not find that Asian hosts charge less for their apartments.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The introduction places this paper in the set reporting lower Black and Asian host prices; Black penalty agrees while Asian penalty does not.
